question: The selling price of 80 items is equal to the cost price of 72 items. What is the percentage of loss incurred in the transaction?
solution:
**Given:**

The selling price of 80 items is equal to the cost price of 72 items.

**Formula used:**

Percentage of Loss = dfrac{(Cost Price - Selling Price)}{Cost Price} times 100

**Calculation:**

Let Cost Price (CP) of 1 item be ₹1

⇒ CP of 72 items = ₹72

Selling Price (SP) of 80 items = ₹72

⇒ SP of 1 item = ₹dfrac{72}{80}

⇒ SP of 1 item = ₹0.9

Loss per item = CP - SP

⇒ Loss per item = ₹1 - ₹0.9

⇒ Loss per item = ₹0.1

Percentage of Loss = dfrac{Loss}{CP} times 100

⇒ Percentage of Loss = dfrac{0.1}{1} times 100

⇒ Percentage of Loss = 10%

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**
